propositions: Structurally divergent provider/model responses can normalize to empty results that are incorrectly treated as valid review outcomes
Tolerant Pydantic parsing in verify_models.py allows unexpected keys and produces empty models without strict validation
Semantically empty verifications (both raw-empty and malformed-to-empty) must never produce valid pass or empty reviews
Empty verification results are already correctly routed to indeterminate by pass3_decide's no-verification rule regardless of whether absence came from raw-empty or malformed-to-empty paths
Telemetry must distinguish four outcome buckets (clean, recovered, empty_outcomes, unrecoverable) at kernel level in verify_findings
Pipeline-level telemetry wiring to emit outcome_counts in plan_review_decide and code_review_decide is tracked separately as follow-up ticket c2c5-53a7-2ce0-4d98
